notes: somatic core 1.4.0: the settled release. one architecture and one checkpoint format (CHECKPOINT.md), opening every somatic core model from 0.1.0 on. the store's fast timescales now read exact ages at any clock (they were rounded by up to 64 tokens past ~16M tokens of life), and no prediction depends on anything after it, even while the store evicts. chat reads the attention window training built (replies were reading one token on rope models). slim copies without optimiser state for sharing. the compiled store path runs wherever numba is installed. updates now arrive through the app.
